checks.name: Empty question validation
checks.observation: Client displays Enter a mathematics question first and focuses the editor.

checks.name: Examples and character count
checks.observation: Algebra and fraction examples fill the editor and update its character count.

checks.name: Keyboard shortcut and progress
checks.observation: Control+Enter submits one request; the button is disabled and progress text appears.

checks.name: Real model answer and equation rendering
checks.observation: The final fraction example returns 7/8 in about 1.1 seconds and renders one KaTeX equation.

checks.name: Copy interaction
checks.observation: The copy operation resolves and the button shows Copied; the source code copies the original answer string.

checks.name: Mobile workspace
checks.observation: At a measured 390px viewport the main content is 343px and document scroll width is 375px; no horizontal overflow.

checks.name: In-app guide
checks.observation: Guide includes question entry, answers, copying, recovery, pipeline and privacy sections.

checks.name: Pipeline console
checks.observation: All eleven stages display completed; actual counts, timings, accepted version 3 and run links are visible.

checks.name: Browser JavaScript errors
checks.observation: No browser error logs were returned for the final workspace.

clipboard_note: The automation clipboard reader did not independently expose the native clipboard; copy success is verified by the resolved browser operation and visible UI state.
